label: Portrait — skin first
brief: Skin tone comes first. Keep the hue of the skin steady (mostly the orange band) and its saturation moderate; smooth its texture slightly without a plastic look. Change the global tone only as far as it helps the skin. Register the face as a skin region with preserve: true, so its hue and saturation are guarded between passes.
convergence_hints: stop when the skin region's hue and saturation are stable and the skin looks smooth but real
